title: unify-terraform-private-state-layout-gpu-iam-networking-migration
author: Liam Park
description: Motivation: Private deployments currently use multiple, inconsistent Terraform state layouts across GPU node pools, IAM roles, and VPC/networking modules. This causes drift, complex state migrations during upgrades, and duplicated codepaths in the private installer. This PR unifies the state layout and module boundaries to a single canonical structure, introduces migration tooling to move existing state into the new layout, and updates Helm + installer docs. Summary of changes: - Consolidate gpu_node_pool, iam, and networking module state under a single 'private' state namespace and standardized remote state key naming. - Introduce a lightweight migration script (terraform-state-migrate.sh) that performs: 1) remote state backup, 2) terraform state mv operations for known resource paths, 3) verification plan. - Add compatibility shims for legacy node pool naming to avoid service disruption during rollout. - Move shared outputs into a 'private_shared' module to reduce circular references. - Update module variable names to be consistent (region -> location, project -> cloud_project) and add deprecation warnings. - Add e2e plan/apply CI job for private deployments to validate module boundaries (runs on a mocked backend in CI). Migration notes: - Existing customers must run terraform-state-migrate.sh from the repo root against their existing remote state bucket; the script performs an automated backup and outputs a verification plan. - Rollback: keep the backup snapshot; migration script emits an undo plan that reverts state moves. - No in-place resource recreations are intended; changes are state moves and variable renames only. Docs: - Updated README/private-deploys.md with step-by-step migration and example Linear/Ticket templates for support. Checklist: - [x] Unify state key layout - [x] Add migration tooling and tests - [x] Update private installer docs - [x] Add CI acceptance job - [x] Run manual migration against internal staging states Related: ENG-1423 (state layout design), ENG-1587 (private installer compatibility).

review_comments: Priya Nair: Nice consolidation. Two requests: (1) please add explicit verification steps in the migration script so operators can validate before and after; (2) add a fast-fail mode if remote state snapshots are not writable.
Liam Park: Addressed both feedbacks: migration script now generates a verification plan and halts if snapshot can't be created. Added explicit logging and exit codes.
Ethan Zhao: Left inline comments about variable rename notices - can we keep backwards-compatible variable mapping for two releases?
Liam Park: Added deprecation warnings and a compatibility layer that accepts old env vars for a two-release window. Documented in README/private-deploys.md.
Marisol Gutierrez: CI job is great. Can we gate the e2e job on a smoke flag to avoid long runs on PRs?
Liam Park: CI now runs the e2e job only for the release and merge pipeline; PRs run the mock plan only.
merge_details: Merged by Priya Nair using squash merge. Commit message summarized state layout unification and included migration script. Changelog entry added.
release_notes: Unify private deployment terraform state layout across GPU node pools, IAM, and networking. Added migration tooling (terraform-state-migrate.sh) and updated private installer docs. No resource recreation expected; follow migration script for safe upgrade.
notes_for_ops: Run scripts/terraform-state-migrate.sh --remote-state s3://<bucket>/private/<env> --dry-run first. Keep the snapshot created by the script. For any failures, contact infra@redwood.com with migration logs.
risk_assessment: Low-Medium: changes are state moves only, but state operations are sensitive. Migration script performs backups and verification. Recommend running in staging first and keeping support on-call during customer migrations.
